title: Re-Extraction (Library of Ruina)
description: Port of qzwxecrv's Re-Extraction (Workshop 2748648361) as host callbacks on observation gates: while the Abnormality Page pick is open, the special button R3 re-rolls the emotion coins of the player's units and starts the pick again. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Re-Extraction
launcher.note: Gives you the ability to re-roll Abnormality Pages by pressing R3. Original mod by [qzwxecrv’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2748648361)

obs._comment: main build ID (first 16 bytes of the module ID, 32 hex digits) -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; word = the 4 bytes at offset read as a little-endian u32. Offsets are the RVAs of dump.cs (main = RVA + 0x234000 in the DmIOS file).

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: LevelUpUI.Update entry (once a frame while the pick UI is active): x0 = the LevelUpUI
StageLibraryFloorModel.StartPickEmotionCard entry: x0 = the floor model, kept to start the pick again
